rationale: C08 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both are letters to committee chairmen concerning assistance to Yugoslavia, move from a factual account of Yugoslavia’s shortages to the resulting jeopardy to the combat effectiveness of its armed forces, connect Yugoslavia’s defensive capacity to the security of the North Atlantic area, state a presidential determination under mutual-defense legislation, authorize specified assistance, and close by identifying the letter as the statutorily required notification. C18 contains closely related machinery and language but is less proximate to the child’s expanded military-and-economic-assistance determination. C06 supplies relevant statutory-administrative context but not the child letter’s form or argumentative sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The situation has become so acute as to jeopardize the combat effectiveness of the Yugoslav armed forces.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The consequent shortage of raw materials, which includes those basic to the needs of the Yugoslav armed forces, is so acute as to jeopardize the combat effectiveness of the Yugoslav armed forces
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive, nearly verbatim language describing the operative factual predicate.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have determined that Yugoslavia is a country which is of direct importance to the defense of the North Atlantic area and that the increased ability of Yugoslavia to defend itself is important to the preservation of the peace and security of the North Atlantic area
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have found that Yugoslavia is a nation whose strategic location makes it of direct importance to the defense of the North Atlantic area, and that an immediate increase in its ability to defend itself ... will contribute to the preservation of the peace and security of the North Atlantic area.
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses the same two-part legal determination, adapted to the Mutual Security Act of 1951.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Military and economic assistance will be furnished to Yugoslavia as a result of this determination
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have determined, therefore ... to provide raw materials and similar supplies for Yugoslavia
shared_material.explanation: Both translate the statutory determination into assistance for Yugoslavia.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This letter constitutes the notification required by Section 101 (a) of the Mutual Security Act of 1951.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This letter constitutes the notification required by Section 408(c) of the Mutual Defense Assistance Act, as amended.
shared_material.explanation: The same notification-letter closing is retained while the governing statute and section are updated.
